name: LED Bulb
description: The dimmable LED bulbs. They have no SET button, status LED or beeper.

operatingFlags.name: programmingLock
operatingFlags.description: The bulb doesn't enter linking mode when it powers up.

operatingFlags.name: powerUpLastState
operatingFlags.description: The bulb powers up to its last state. Clear, it powers up on, which is the default: to full on if it was off, or to its last level.

operatingFlags.name: ledOnTransmit
operatingFlags.description: The status LED blinks when the device sends an Insteon message.

verification.note: The LED Bulb Developer Notes list bit 1 of the 0x00 reply as not used.

operatingFlags.name: radioOff
operatingFlags.description: The device doesn't originate RF messages. It still repeats the RF messages it hears.

verification.note: The LED Bulb Developer Notes list bit 6 of the 0x00 reply as not used.

operatingFlags.name: powerLineOff
operatingFlags.description: Insteon communication over the powerline is off. The device turns it back on whenever it powers up.

verification.note: The LED Bulb Developer Notes list bit 7 of the 0x00 reply as not used.

operatingFlags.name: applicationRetries
operatingFlags.description: The device retries application messages as many times as its ALL-Link database says, and reports cleanup errors.

verification.note: The LED Bulb Developer Notes don't list the 0x05 reply.

operatingFlags.name: x10Off
operatingFlags.description: X10 sending and receiving are off.

verification.note: The LED Bulb Developer Notes don't list the 0x05 reply.

operatingFlags.name: errorBlink
operatingFlags.description: The status LED blinks when a communication error occurs.

verification.note: The LED Bulb Developer Notes don't list the 0x05 reply.

operatingFlags.name: cleanupReport
operatingFlags.description: The device sends a success report after the cleanup messages that follow a group command.

verification.note: The LED Bulb Developer Notes don't list the 0x05 reply.

operatingFlags.name: checksumRequired
operatingFlags.description: Extended Set and ALL-Link database write messages must carry a checksum in D14.

verification.note: The LED Bulb Developer Notes don't list the 0x05 reply.

readings.name: databaseDelta
readings.description: A count that goes up whenever the ALL-Link database changes. It clears when the bulb powers up.

readings.name: crcErrorCount
readings.description: The number of messages received with a CRC error. It clears when the bulb powers up and rolls over from 255 to 0.

verification.note: The Insteon Developer's Guide gives query 0x02 as a signal-to-noise value; later sources count messages with CRC errors there.

readings.name: signalToNoiseFailureCount
readings.description: The number of signal-to-noise failures. It clears when the bulb powers up and rolls over from 255 to 0.

verification.note: The LED Bulb Developer Notes don't list cmd2 0x08 or 0x09; they turn linking at power-up off with programming lock (cmd2 0x00) instead.
The LED Bulb Developer Notes don't list cmd2 0x08 or 0x09; they turn linking at power-up off with programming lock (cmd2 0x00) instead.

flagCommands.name: smartHopsOn
flagCommands.description: Starts each message with the hop count of the last acknowledgment received (smart hops).

flagCommands.name: smartHopsOff
flagCommands.description: Starts each message with one hop.

notes: When it powers up, the bulb sends a SET button broadcast and stays in responder linking mode for 5 seconds, unless programming lock is on. To link it, put the controller in linking mode, then power the bulb up.
The bulb's levels and ramp rates differ from other dimmers': at 0x0F it gives about a tenth of its full light, and at 0x7F more than half.
The LED Bulb Developer Notes give ramp rate 0x00 as about 2 seconds when setting it and as 9 minutes in their ramp table; the rest of the table runs from 8 minutes at 0x01 to 0.1 second at 0x1F.
Of the extended Get reply, the LED Bulb Developer Notes use only D7, the ramp rate.

values.name: rampRate
values.description: The ramp rate, from 0x01 (8 minutes) to 0x1F (0.1 second). 0x00 is 2 seconds. 0x1C (0.5 second) by default.

verification.note: The LED Bulb Developer Notes send D1 0x00; other products ignore D1 for settings that aren't per button.

standardCommands.name: lightOn
standardCommands.description: Turns the bulb on to the level in cmd2 at its ramp rate.

parameter.name: onLevel
parameter.description: The level to go to, from 0x00 (off) to 0xFF (full).

standardCommands.name: lightOnFast
standardCommands.description: Turns the bulb full on instantly. The bulb ignores cmd2.

standardCommands.name: lightOff
standardCommands.description: Turns the bulb off at its ramp rate.

standardCommands.name: readStatus
standardCommands.description: Reads the bulb's level. The acknowledgment's cmd1 carries the ALL-Link database delta.

standardCommands.name: instantChange
standardCommands.description: Sets the bulb to the level in cmd2 instantly.

parameter.name: onLevel
parameter.description: The level to go to, from 0x00 (off) to 0xFF (full).

standardCommands.name: onAtRampRate
standardCommands.description: Turns the bulb on to a level at a ramp rate, both given in cmd2.

parameter.name: levelAndRampRate
parameter.description: Bits 4 through 7 give the level, which is 16 times their value plus 0x0F, and bits 0 through 3 the ramp rate, which is 2 times their value plus 1.

standardCommands.name: offAtRampRate
standardCommands.description: Turns the bulb off at a ramp rate given in cmd2. The bulb ignores bits 4 through 7.

parameter.name: rampRate
parameter.description: The ramp rate, which is 2 times this value plus 1.
